items.text: Dịka mgbe m bụ nwata, mgbe Maman na-atọpụ eri akwa uwe ochie, anyị na-eburu eriri ahụ gburugburu ụlọ ka eri akwa ahụ ghara ịkpọkọta n'elu ibe ya.
items.q: Is it clear the children walk around inside the house, holding the yarn?
before: …anya nke ihe omume ụwa ma a hapụ ide ha ede n'ebe a. E dere ha ka ha ghọọ àkwà mmiri n'agbata ụwa m na ụwa gị. Àkwà mmiri si n'ụwa m, n'oge m na-ede ahịrịokwu ndị a, gaa n'ụwa gị, n'oge ị ga-anọdụ ala ịgụ ha. Site n'akụkụ a, m na-atọpụ eriri okwu ahụ, gị onwe gị na-achịkọta ya site n'akụkụ nke ọzọ.

items.text: N'ime ụlọ nke dị na ngwụcha ogige ụlọ ahụ, n'akụkụ ekwu ọkụ, m tọgbọworo n'afọ m, nọ n'etiti uche ịchọta ụzọ mfe iji dozie ọtụtụ ajụjụ Konkoor ndị metụtara triigọnọmetrị site na iji cheekụl ọtụtụ ndị ahụ.
items.q: Is it clear Amir solves trigonometry problems using the unit circle?
before: – Ya mere, sọsọ maka nchere ahụ niile m chere, nọdụ ala n'akụkụ m ntakịrị ọzọ.

…Ikuku enweghị oyi, ma obi m na-ere ọkụ. Ọ ka na-ere ọkụ ugbu a. Ọkụ nke icheta ntabi anya nkwụsị ahụ. Na eleghị anya, ọkụ nke ichefu ihe m na-eche na m ekwesighị ichefu. Ihe dị ka enweghị udo, otu udo na-enweghị nke guzo n'azụ ígwè ojii. Ewoo maka nchefu, ewoo maka ichefu, ewoo maka nchefu mmadụ.

items.text: Obi ụtọ maka ụzọ mfe na bara uru m chọtara, ebiliri m n'akụkụ ekwu ọkụ ahụ wee jiri urukurubụba mkpuchi akwụkwọ ahụ n'ahụ mgbidi, n'akụkụ ndụmọdụ Konkoor ndị ọzọ.
items.q: Is it clear Amir tapes the sheet to the wall beside his other notes?
before: N'ehihịghị m ya anya, ọ gafere n'ihu anya m: Mahboubeh na-ahapụ akwa mgbochi anya nke dị n'ihu ọnụ ụzọ ogige ụlọ wee mechie ọnụ ụzọ ahụ. Ọ bụ eziokwu. Achọghịkwa m icheta igu usoro na ndụmọdụ Konkoor dị iche iche nke isiokwu trigọnọmetrị.

items.text: Ọ na-emegharị nkwụ ọsọ ọsọ. Ọ na-awụ nkwụ karịrị akarị n'elu ihe ọtụtụ ahụ, wee were ụfọdụ laghachi.
items.q: The grocer is weighing chickpeas. Is 'nkwụ' the right word for chickpeas?
before: Anyị guzoro n'akụkụ ụlọ ahịa Haaj Kazem. Ghassem na-efeghar aka ya nye ya mgbe niile. Aka Haaj Kazem na-ama jijiji mgbe niile. Mgbe anyị na Maman gara ebe ahụ, ha na-amakwa jijiji.

items.text: Ihe ọ bụla ọ zụrụ n'oge ahụ, echere m na ọ ga-aba ụba ugbu a ruo puku ugboro iri.
items.q: Does 'puku ugboro iri' clearly mean ten thousand times as much?
before: – Anya Ugo, bịa. Ị hapụrụ enyo anya gị n'ụkwụ akwa m.

…ọ ga-abụrịrị onye nwetara akara ugo si Sharif tupu ọ hapụ Iran, ọ gaara ahapụ Iran ozugbo ọ gụsịrị bachelor. Ewezuga nke ahụ, nwoke aghụghọ ahụ ekwughị okwu ọ bụla banyere ego ọ tinyere, ma m ji ihe ọ bụla mara na o zụrụ Bitcoin n'oge ahụ ma kpakọba akụ ya. Isi ya na-anọ n'ime laptop ya mgbe niile.

items.text: – Enyi nwa nwanne nna anyị nwoke, onye nwe ọka aka nke ọgọ nwoke anyị, onye bụ ọgaranya kachasị na Tehran, gwara ya banyere ya.
items.q: Does it clearly say: the friend of the cousin of our in-law's master craftsman?
before: – Nyeghachi m ya. Dị ka a ga-asị na ọ maara otu ndị nwere waya na-arụ ọrụ.
Taghi jidere aka Hamid na ikuku zọpụta walkman ahụ. Ma Yaser nwetakwara ọtụtụ aka na ụkwụ. Hamid kwuru:

items.text: Anwapụta na ọ bụrụ na m rụsie ọrụ n'aka ya ntakịrị, n'ihu unu ọ ga-ada azụ kwuo ka unu gaa n'ihu.
items.q: He bets the man would pull down his own trousers for them. Is that clear?
before: …ọnwa atọ gara aga, elewo onwe ya n'ime ntakịrị ntakịrị, adịghịkwa akparịta ụka mmadụ nke ga-eme ka anyị mata atụmatụ ya. Obi ya na uche ya adabawo n'ala mbụ nke ụlọ Abu-Reyhan, n'etiti ụmụ akwụkwọ ngalaba nrụ ụgbọ mmiri. Eskandar nọdụrụ n'etiti ụlọ n'elu kapeeti, chere ihu Hooman na Sajad, na-asị:

– ... Unu chọrọ ịnwapụta ihe? Amaara m mmụọ mmadụ a dị ka ọbọ aka m ugbu a. Ihe ọ bụla ọ na-eme sitere n'echiche na-ezughị ezu. Lee ihe a nke ọ na-ada n'ịhụnanya. Mmadụ ọ na-ada n'ịhụnanya otu a n'ọnwa ole na ole? Ọzọkwa, nwaanyị lụrụ di.

items.text: O ji ọsọ karịa ọsọ ìhè gbapụ, ma ọ bụghị, agaara m etikwasị ya ihe n'ike.
items.q: The speaker means he'd have hung him up by the backside. Is that clear?
before: …ka ọ gaara adị mgbe ahụ. Ka Farid na-agba ọsọ, ụkwụ ya zọrọ akwụkwọ Eskandar, dọwaa mkpuchi akwụkwọ ozi ya. Otu akụkụ nke aha ogologo akwụkwọ ahụ pụtara ìhè: "Puku Iri ... Ihe ịtụnanya, Ihe ọmụma ... Akụkọ ... Maka ..." Farid abịaghị n'ụlọ ahụ ụbọchị abalị abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ. Eskandar nọ na-asị:
– Ngwere obere ahụ mebikwara iwu physics.
